name: Next JS (pm2 + console cmd)
author: ok.shiroko@zass.cloud
description: Host a Next.js application with reliable 0.0.0.0 binding, auto package manager detection, pm2 process management (zero-downtime reload), authenticated private git clone, and optional live console command execution.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# NodeJS App Installation Script
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 libtool

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

build_git_url() {
    local url="$1"
    if [[ "$url" != *.git ]]; then
        url="${url%/}.git"
    fi
    if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        url="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo "$url" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi
    echo "$url"
}

if [ -n "${GIT_URL}" ]; then
    FULL_URL=$(build_git_url "${GIT_URL}")

    if [ ! "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
        echo -e "cloning files into repo"
        if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
            git clone "${FULL_URL}" .
        else
            git clone --single-branch --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${FULL_URL}" .
        fi
    fi
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/package.json ] && [ -n "${NEXT_VERSION}" ]; then
    echo -e "package.json not found, scaffolding a new Next.js app (version: ${NEXT_VERSION})"
    cd /mnt/server
    if [ "${NEXT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
        npx --yes create-next-app@latest . --yes
    else
        npx --yes create-next-app@${NEXT_VERSION} . --yes
    fi
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    corepack enable >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    PM_CHOICE=${PACKAGE_MANAGER:-auto}

    if [ "${PM_CHOICE}" = "auto" ]; then
        if [ -f /mnt/server/pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            PM_CHOICE=pnpm
        elif [ -f /mnt/server/yarn.lock ]; then
            PM_CHOICE=yarn
        else
            PM_CHOICE=npm
        fi
    fi

    echo -e "using package manager: ${PM_CHOICE}"

    # NOTE: full install (incl. devDependencies) is required here because
    # `npm run build` / `next build` needs devDependencies (typescript, etc.)
    # when NODE_RUN_ENV=start builds at container startup.
    if [ "${PM_CHOICE}" = "pnpm" ]; then
        if [ -f /mnt/server/pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
            pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        else
            pnpm install
        fi
    elif [ "${PM_CHOICE}" = "yarn" ]; then
        yarn install
    else
        if [ -f /mnt/server/package-lock.json ] || [ -f /mnt/server/npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then
            npm ci
        else
            npm install
        fi
    fi

fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Next.js Version
variables.description: Versi Next.js yang di-install jika folder server & git repository  url kosong.

variables.name: Node ENV
variables.description:
Mode menjalankan aplikasi. 'start' = mode production, aplikasi di-build otomatis dulu sebelum dijalankan (dipakai untuk server yang online ke publik). 

'dev' = mode development, tanpa build, perubahan real-time (hot reload), cocok untuk testing & pengembangan, jangan dipakai untuk server publik karena lebih lambat & belum optimal.

variables.name: Package Manager
variables.description: Tools yang dipakai untuk install dependencies project.

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description:
Alamat repository Git yang mau di-clone otomatis ke server saat instalasi pertama kali. Contoh: https://github.com/username/nama-repo.git. Kalau repo-nya private, isi juga Git Username dan Git Access Token di bawah, kalau tidak clone akan gagal.

CATATAN: Hanya berlaku jika folder server kosong

variables.name: Branch
variables.description: Nama branch dari repository yang mau dipakai, contoh: main, master, atau develop. Kosongkan untuk otomatis pakai branch default repository tersebut.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Kalau diisi 1, server otomatis mengambil update terbaru dari Git Repository URL (git pull) setiap kali server di-restart/dinyalakan. Isi 0 kalau kamu mau update kode secara manual sendiri.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username akun Git kamu (GitHub/GitLab/dll). Hanya perlu diisi kalau repo di Git Repository URL bersifat PRIVATE. Kalau repo-nya publik, biarkan kosong.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal Access Token dari akun Git kamu. Hanya perlu diisi kalau repo di Git Repository URL bersifat PRIVATE, dan harus diisi berbarengan dengan Git Username di atas. Di GitHub, token ini dibuat lewat Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens.

variables.name: Enable Console Commands (beta)
variables.description:
Kalau diisi 1, kolom Console di panel bisa dipakai untuk mengetik perintah bebas seperti npm install atau pm2 reload app.

PERINGATAN: siapa pun yang punya akses Console ke server ini (termasuk subuser tambahan yang kamu invite) otomatis bisa menjalankan perintah apa saja di dalam server. Biarkan 0 (mati) kalau server ini bakal dipakai/diakses orang lain selain kamu.
